title: Spanish and Italian import guidance keeps the six corrected grammatical forms
steps: Load the committed locale bundle through its actual module factory and locale registration.
Compare the six approved Spanish and Italian values in both source and runtime dictionaries.
expect: All four Spanish statements use pide while preserving their full text and link markup.
Both Italian noun positions use verifica while preserving their full text and placeholder.
The shipped runtime dictionaries equal the approved source sentences.
evidence: All six incorrect words were reproduced on develop 8555cf3682 before editing. Only the six approved source values and their generated bundle entries change.
fence: Exact approved source sentences and shipped bundle registration; no CMS import or credential access.
